name: @proteles/sdk-workspace
description: The Proteles SDKs: the @proteles/* TypeScript packages (npm workspaces under packages/), and the native iOS and Android SDKs under mobile/.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @proteles/js && npm run build -w @proteles/bff && sh -euc 'for p in packages/*/; do npm run build --if-present -w "$p" || exit 1; done'
scripts.test: sh -euc 'for p in packages/*/; do npm run test --if-present -w "$p" || exit 1; done' && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:vectors && npm run test:tools
scripts.test:tools: node tools/generate-management-wire.mjs --self-test && node tools/generate-management-enums.mjs --self-test && node tools/generate-management-wire.mjs --check && node tools/generate-management-enums.mjs --check && node tools/npm-publish-readiness-test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: sh -euc 'for p in packages/*/; do npm run typecheck --if-present -w "$p" || exit 1; done' && npm run typecheck:scripts
